title: Challenge
description: Challenge message notified by the station to the app on BLE characteristic FFF4, answering the Hello. Carries the BLE version the station chose, its nonce and ephemeral key, its certificate, its connectivity, the availability of its services and the digest of its FFF2 catalog, all signed by the station (06-security.md §6.5.2). It is the app's one source of availability.

bleVersion.description: The BLE protocol version of this session: one of the Hello's bleVersions, chosen by the station (profiles/offline/ble-handshake.md §3).

stationNonce.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte cryptographically random nonce (exactly 44 Base64 characters; N16 — was minLength:1).

stationEphemeralPubKey.description: The station's per-handshake ephemeral P-256 public key (compressed SEC1, Base64). ee = ECDH(appEphemeral, stationEphemeral) is the session key's input (06-security.md §6.5), authenticated by stationSignature. Freshly generated per handshake.

stationCertificate.description: The station's mTLS client certificate, DER, Base64 (06-security.md §4.4), whose subject CN is the station's stationId. The app validates it against a Station CA of its trust bundle and that CA's CRL before it sends any credential (06-security.md §6.5.2).

stationConnectivity.description: Current network connectivity status of the station

availableServices.description: Every service the station's catalog binds to each of its bays, with whether the station can start it now. Signed with the rest of the Challenge, and the app's one source of availability (profiles/offline/ble-transport.md §4). Empty while the station holds no service catalog.

available.description: Whether the station can start this service on this bay now.

catalogDigest.description: SHA-256 of the OSPP Canonical Form of the catalog the station serves on FFF2 now, Base64 (44 characters; profiles/offline/ble-transport.md §4). Signed with the rest of the Challenge: the app sends no credential when it differs from the digest of the catalog it chose from (profiles/offline/ble-handshake.md §3).

stationSignature.description: The station's ECDSA P-256 signature (DER, low-s, Base64) with its certificate key over the content of 06-security.md §6.5.2 - a fixed OSPP context, then a hash of the Hello's wire bytes and of this Challenge without this member, in the OSPP Canonical Form. The station builds that content itself and never signs a digest the app supplies.
